'''''Cularin 1''''' was a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] that was used by the [[Cularin Militia]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] once met [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Xirossk]] on it and he sent them on a mission to [[Uffel]].
